name: Tasogare no Kimi Wolfinne Dai 2 Bu ~Oujo to Megami to Yami no Ryuu~
original_name: 黄昏の君 ヴォルフィーネ 第2部 ～王女と女神と闇の竜～
source:
Nothing is kept forever, and the peace is not an exception.
Terrifying voices are calling from far away...
Evil beings await for the opportunity to invade the Kingdom of Noon.
Empress Fimosi's new adventure begins!

"You are the Savior Knight!"
